Where you’ll study

The dental college and clinics form a separate campus area, approximately 1 km from the nursing compound.

Living on campus

The dental campus has its own dining hall and hostels, with staff quarters opposite.

For course details, entry requirements, approved seats and council approvals, please contact the college office. We’ll share the current information for your admission year.
